newsitem.title: PAKISTAN: Pakistani stocks rise amid hopes of foreign buying.
newsitem.headline: Pakistani stocks rise amid hopes of foreign buying.

text.p: Pakistani stocks rose on Sunday after Pakistani global depositary receipts gained abroad, lending support to hopes that foreign buying may filter into select blue chips, dealers said.
"Talk of selective buying by foreign funds helped improve sentiment," dealer Ali Hussain Rajabali said, but added that volume was low as local institutions showed little interest.

The Karachi Stock Exchange 100-share index rose 14.07 points, or 1.04 percent, to end at 1,370.70. Gainers led losers 109 to 86. Turnover fell to 21.57 million shares from 22.92 million in the previous session.
Adamjee Insurance rose 3.0 rupees to 89 rupees. Saif Textile rose 1.0 to 15.50 and Sapphire Fibres 2.0 to 30. Dewan Salman Fibre to 0.30 to 32.65.
Hub Power Co rose 0.35 to 33.75 and Pakistan State Oil 5.0 to 272. PTCL rose 0.20 to 24.50. Fauji Fertilizer rose 3.0 to 69 and ICI Pakistan 0.15 to 18.60.
